prior_art.name: Trace / OptoPrime
prior_art.mechanism_overlap: Executed DAG values and output feedback propagate to trainable heterogeneous parameters. OptoPrime reports variables, immutable inputs, constraints, outputs, operator code and feedback; optional memory retains earlier variable/feedback examples. Code parameters can change the executed workflow.
prior_art.boundary: Direct prior art for graph learning and the neural-network analogy. Textual proposals are not numerical backpropagation or verified causal attribution. Read selected OPTO/optimizer sections and implementation; did not install or execute upstream.

prior_art.name: GEPA
prior_art.mechanism_overlap: The paper evolves prompts from scored trajectories and keeps complementary candidates. Current code exposes arbitrary prompt/program candidates, evaluator(score,info), user-controlled reflective JSON, custom proposers and coupled component updates. Verified-fact routing can be expressed inside this adapter.
prior_art.boundary: A domain-specific gate is not established as a new optimizer. GEPA does not supply market truth or Zenith chronology. Per-example failure scores in its adapter differ from native pending/comparability rules; preserve the native evaluator. Read selected method/adapter paths only; no upstream execution.

prior_art.name: QuantAgent, Wang et al. 2024
prior_art.mechanism_overlap: Inner writer/judge refinement plus real-data outer evaluation and retained successful/failed experiences already describes the broad finance learning loop.
prior_art.boundary: Alpha-factor code search, not our exact-close task. Official code was not located in the bounded search; no implementation or convergence claim transfers.

prior_art.name: FinCon
prior_art.mechanism_overlap: Compare consecutive training trading trajectories, conceptualize profitable/losing behavior, update belief prompts, and selectively propagate guidance to analyst roles. Trading-action overlap supplies a verbal update-rate heuristic.
prior_art.boundary: Read Algorithm 1 and the risk/memory method sections. Fixed hierarchy and conceptual attribution do not establish intervention causality. The pinned official README says full implementation is unreleased; code license does not relicense the paper or data.

rejected_broad_claims: A reasoning DAG learns from its own errors.
Node skills, context allocation and topology are trainable parameters.
Language feedback acts like a neural gradient.
A financial agent updates beliefs after backtesting.
novelty_assessment.candidate_domain_claim: Verified information-state facts can improve the selection of a legal repair family over score-only or ordinary trace reflection, without rewarding future information access.
novelty_assessment.why_this_is_still_not_a_novelty_finding: The closest generic optimizers can express the proposed gate. Its value must be shown by controlled comparisons; a successful engineered combination can be useful without originating a new learning algorithm.

existing: GodModeEngine executes the explicitly admitted compact STOCK → CP1 → CP2 graph.
research/diagnosis.py distinguishes bound mechanical observations from unknown records and causal hypotheses.
research/reflection.py retains development successes, failures, unresolved denominators and source hashes, then validates one participating-node skill/context change.
system/lib/reasoning_policy.py records missing, omitted and excerpted dependencies under a declared source-character budget.
research/cohort.py freezes comparable arms and rejects partial scoring support; later assessment is sealed.
current_native_state.missing_bounded_slice: No inspected native consumer uses verified diagnosis to declare which intervention families are justified before a proposer chooses one. A low final score alone does not identify that family.
limits: A source-character retention receipt does not prove which semantic facts survived, were relevant or were used by the model.
No-omission cases supply no witnessed justification for a context-allocation repair.
The current price-only study is one CP2 skill change; it cannot establish learned topology or multi-source allocation.
Nested rolling selection and lifetime history-exposure accounting remain planned.

principle_critique.identifiability: The same wrong output can arise from missing information, an ignored retained fact, a wrong rule, or model variability. A downstream miss and ancestry graph do not distinguish these. A controlled intervention can identify an effect within a specified environment; it is not universal causal attribution.
principle_critique.acquisition: Changing acquired evidence changes the observed information set. An acquisition repair needs an explicit point-in-time source-access intervention; it is not a matched-input skill update.
principle_critique.admission: If the needed source first becomes available after the issue time, rejecting it is correct. There may be no legally identifiable forecast. A benchmark must reward uncertainty or refusal rather than hindsight access.
principle_critique.retention: Omission of an admitted dependency is witnessed. Its necessity still requires a task-grounded hypothesis and a matched re-execution. Excerpted context is not automatically a defect.
principle_critique.reasoning: Full retained context does not certify comprehension. A skill change remains a hypothesis to test, not the fallback causal verdict.
principle_critique.more_consequential_objective: Learn the smallest legal change that restores evidence-preserving task behavior and generalizes to hidden cases, while maintaining previous successes and recording its cost. A noisy five-day price score cannot establish that mechanism.

recommended_controlled_benchmark.task: A controlled evidence-preserving computation in the native engine. Use clearly labeled synthetic typed episodes with a published deterministic target-generating rule from information available at A; the target observation at B remains evaluator-only. This is not a simulated claim of market edge.
recommended_controlled_benchmark.minimal_forward_graph: Reuse the compact STOCK → CP1 → CP2 execution and its actual contracts. If the synthetic computation cannot satisfy those contracts without weakening them, use a native typed evidence-normalization task instead; do not invent a second executor.
first_repairable_faults: Omit an adjustment-bearing dependency view while preserving the admitted source pool and immutable temporal cutoff.
Keep the needed context, but inject a bounded incorrect sign or unit reasoning rule.
exclude_from_first_loss_comparison: Acquisition failures that require changing the information set.
Admission cases where only future information could solve the task.
recommended_controlled_benchmark.training_evidence: A fresh proposer sees bound training-only inputs, outputs, matured scores and verified receipts, including successes. It receives no synthetic fault tags, evaluator target function values for hidden cases, hidden outcomes or informal summaries from other studies.
controls: Targeted single-family repair selected from training evidence.
Wrong-family repair with a matched proposal/execution allowance.
Generic scored-trace reflection without the verified-fact gate; an optional score-only proposer isolates trace value.
hidden_cases: New numerical values, admissible source ordering and nuisance context, declared before proposal.
At least one indistinguishable visible trace where localization is underdetermined; correct diagnosis remains uncertain.
Untouched successful cases to test regressions.
measurements: Localization against the scripted mechanism, with uncertain cases scored separately.
Exact controlled-task correctness and native acceptance after the frozen repair.
Complete paired per-issue error/support, including failures and no-change outcomes.
Nonregression on prior successes and violation of temporal or contract boundaries.
All attempted proposal/execution calls, tokens, elapsed time and reported cost.
recommended_controlled_benchmark.falsification: Reject the useful-gating claim if hidden-case improvement or localization fails against equal-budget generic reflection/wrong-family controls, if success preservation worsens, or if the effect requires leaked labels or looser native acceptance.
test_boundaries: Mocked deterministic fixtures establish mechanics and oracle separation only, not learned improvement.
Actual proposer/executor identities and candidate bytes must be frozen to assess learning.
A hand-designed defect suite tests generalization within that suite, not open-world causal diagnosis.
Joint faults may need interacting repairs; one successful single-field test does not establish topology learning.

minimal_implementation_proposal.change: Add a small deterministic eligibility projection to the existing bound reflection packet. It names witnessed information-state observations, candidate parameter families, unknowns and immutable constraints. The existing one-field compiler and native executor remain the apply boundary.
gate_rules: Future/unbound evidence remains forbidden; unknown records grant no witnessed repair claim.
Missing acquisition is routed to a separately declared source intervention, not a skill_addon that fabricates data.
Verified omission permits a bounded context-allocation hypothesis at that node, with total context budget fixed; no assertion that omission caused the miss.
No verified omission means no context-specific repair claim. Skill proposals remain allowed as explicitly unproven hypotheses.
Each candidate retains one component/change, source identity, complete denominator and no live mutation permission.
first_tests: Bound omission versus unavailable/unknown records yield different eligible intervention descriptions.
Forged or changed source/policy/trace hashes are rejected.
Changing evaluator truth at B cannot change the frozen A prompt or candidate-independent feed admission.
Hidden assessment cases stay outside proposal construction; training successes remain alongside failures and the complete denominator.
No-change and wrong-family controls execute through the same native contracts.

current_study_boundary.allowed_current_intervention: One frozen CP2 skill_addon replacement only, proposed elsewhere from a fresh bound development-only context.
no_claims: No context/topology adaptation measured by the price-only study.
No endogenous graph-learning improvement or market edge established by this synthesis.
